notes.title: ON KICKSTARTER NOW
notes.content:
Help to SURVIVE on KICKSTARTER & be part of the Game!

Lab 7: Cold Nights is officially live on Kickstarter now. You have multiple ways to be part of the game or just profit by being one of the first supporter and get a cheap price.

Here is the "optional" list for stretch goals.
